liquidbounce.module.example.description: Greets you at a configurable interval.
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.descriptio: Drops hits like HitSelect (attack cancelled, swing still sent). Improves movement, reduces KB and increases crits.
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.chan: Chance that an attack will be considered for dropping.
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.mode: Pause: static - pauses N ticks after a hit. Active: dynamic - only pauses when advantageous.
Ticks to pause after a hit (static).
Dynamic hit selection - only pauses when beneficial.
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.pref: Which benefit to prioritize. Both still give some of the other.
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.only: Drop the hit if target still has hurtTime > MaxTargetHurtTime (invulnerable, would do no damage).
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.maxT: Max target hurtTime allowed before dropping.
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.alwa: If you were just hit (hurtTime>0) always pass the hit (counter-hit = less KB).
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.only: Only pass hits while you are hurt (extreme).
liquidbounce.module.hitSelect.value.chat: Log every 10 hits how many were dropped/passed.
